entries.intent_summary: Create an internal developer portal with a canonical service catalog, ownership metadata, runbooks, dependencies, service tiers, maturity scorecards and paved deployment paths.
entries.author: Vikram Rao
entries.outcome_notes: Pilot running. Continue the Backstage-based pilot and evaluate Harness IDP scorecard patterns before considering a vendor change.

entries.intent_summary: Standardise feature flags, canary cohorts, automated deployment health verification and rollback guardrails for high-risk releases.
entries.author: Leena Rao
entries.outcome_notes: Implementation approved. Reuse createCanaryPlan and verifyDeploymentHealth from packages/release-guard.

entries.intent_summary: Measure deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and recovery time by service tier without scoring individual developers.
entries.author: Maya Singh
entries.outcome_notes: Baseline complete. Services with current runbooks recover faster; improve readiness metadata before adding metrics.

entries.intent_summary: Link postmortems to services, owners, runbooks and repeated failure modes so future work retrieves operational lessons.
entries.author: Kabir Malhotra
entries.outcome_notes: Pilot running. Reuse tools/incident-linker/index.py extract_failure_taxonomy before writing another parser.

entries.intent_summary: Customers need a written success metric and proof-of-value structure to measure and demonstrate business value during pilots.
entries.author: Rhea Bose
entries.outcome_notes: Evidence confirmed. Pipeline decision: do not default to a free pilot; use a paid 30-day proof of value with a written success metric.
